Each source has its own page with structured front matter. The schema is documented in [source metadata](../docs/source-metadata.qmd). Controlled values are listed in [vocabularies](../docs/vocabularies.qmd) and [evidence statuses](../docs/evidence-status.qmd).

This catalogue now includes:

- one clearly labelled **[example / template record](example-template-source-record.qmd)** (not a completed research item)
- four remaining **[wanted sources](../research/wanted-sources.qmd)** named in the commissioning issue (Creekview evaluation, *Keys on Freedom*, ECPM manual(s), ministry CSIL pilot/design records)
- the November 2008 **[CSIL Program Review Synthesis Report](2008-program-review-synthesis.qmd)**, inspected as an Internet Archive Microlog fiche (no longer copy-sought)
- inspected contemporaneous records (Hansard 1984 and 1986; Haw 1989; HEU *Guardian* Nov/Dec 1995 CSIL passage)
- inspected bibliographic records (Mattinson & Rompf 1987 PubMed abstract; Roeher / Salisbury bibliography)
- later official and organizational records (Ombudsperson *Best of Care* 2012; IFRC and SCI BC pages; current ministry and VCH CSIL pages; Order of Canada citation)

Narrative chapters that use these records: [Creekview](../history/creekview.qmd), [ECPM](../history/ecpm.qmd), [CSIL design and pilot](../history/csil-pilot.qmd), and [later evolution](../history/evolution.qmd). A [state of the evidence](../history/index.qmd#state-of-the-evidence) summary lives on the History index.

Do not treat a catalogue row as proof that this archive has inspected the original 1980s–90s manuals or ministry files. Check `verification_status` and `availability`. Check the annotation before treating a later webpage as confirmation of a 1980s–90s fact.
